name: Critical minerals
summary: China's rare-earth export-control pause expires 10 Nov with no renewal announced
state: China's one-year suspension of its October 2025 rare-earth export controls, including the 0.1% content rule, expires on 10 Nov, and no renewal had been announced as of 5 Nov (Yahoo Finance; Technology.org). Lapsed controls would bring back tighter licensing. No production stoppages outside China have been confirmed, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Manufacturers of magnets, motors and electronics face licensing delays if controls return.
rubric_hit: Export controls pending/licensing risk = Watch; no stoppages outside China

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — China rare earth export pause nears expiry
Technology.org — China's rare-earth export pause: what ends on 10 November

why: Rare earths, gallium, germanium and graphite are chokepoints for chips, EVs and defence — and China dominates processing.
drivers: Export controls, trade disputes, mine outages, stockpiling.

rubric.alert: Export bans in force that are causing reported production stoppages outside China.
rubric.watch: New export controls announced or licensing slowed.
rubric.normal: No new export restrictions in the past month.
